title: Jesus Heals the Centurion's Servant! 🛡️ Say the Word | Bible Lesson for Kids | Sunday School
tags: say the word and my servant will be healed
top:
Imagine you are very, very sick, and the doctor is far away. What could you do? 🤒 Join us for the amazing story of Jesus healing the centurion's servant, from Luke 7 and Matthew 8.

A brave Roman soldier loved his servant very much. He believed Jesus had the power to help, so he sent his friends with a message: "Just say the word, and my servant will be healed." Jesus was amazed at his faith! 🌟 And when the friends got back home, the servant was healed. 💚

📖 Memory verse: "But say the word, and my servant will be healed." (Luke 7:7)
🎯 Lesson: Faith and Helpfulness. Trust Jesus, and care for others who are sick or sad!
🙏 Great for Sunday School, Kindergarten and family devotion time.
